seo.title: Digital Marketing & Social Media Services | SynergyFirst Digital
seo.metaDescription: Digital marketing and social media services for local businesses: clear, consistent campaigns and content that strengthen brand recall and keep you visible.
seo.ogDescription: Clear, consistent campaigns and content that strengthen brand recall for local businesses.

sections.subheading: Clear, consistent campaigns and content designed to strengthen brand recall and keep your business visible in the right places.

sections.heading: Stay in front of the customers who already know you exist
body: A website earns attention; marketing keeps it. Consistent campaigns and content help people remember your business, come back to it and recommend it, whether they find you on search, on social media or in their inbox.
We plan marketing and social media work around your goals and your customers, and connect it back to your website so every campaign has somewhere useful to send people.

sections.heading: What our digital marketing and social media work covers
sections.intro: Marketing is scoped around your business, not sold as a fixed package.

items.title: Campaign planning
items.body: A clear plan for what to say, to whom and where, tied to a real business goal.

items.title: Content creation
items.body: Consistent posts and content that reflect your brand and speak to your customers.

items.title: Social media presence
items.body: Help keeping your social profiles active, on-brand and connected to your website.

items.title: Website-connected campaigns
items.body: Landing pages and calls to action so campaigns lead to enquiries and bookings.

items.title: Blog support
items.body: The Business plan includes one to two SEO blog posts per month to keep your site fresh and useful.

items.title: Reporting
items.body: Analytics show what is working so effort goes where it pays off.

sections.heading: Scoped with you, not bundled by default
body: Beyond the SEO blog posts in the Business plan, digital marketing and social media work is not part of the standard website plans. We scope it with you on a discovery call, so you only pay for what fits your goals.
We do not promise follower counts, leads or sales figures. We promise consistent, well-planned work and honest reporting.
